Name: Sable the Gambler
Dialogue: Pick a base. Pay the gold. What's rolled inside... that's between you and fate.
No refunds. Fate doesn't take returns.
I once rolled a king his crown. Rolled the next man a hat.
The house always wins. Lucky for you, out here I AM the house.
Every piece I sell is a mystery. Some are even good ones.
You look lucky today. That's what I tell everyone.
